verdict.rationale: Attio provides direct MCP integration to connect Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools to search, update, and manage the workspace via natural language, plus an AI layer that lets users 'Ask Attio to build workflows for you just by describing the goal' and 'Search, update, and create with AI.' This is corroborated by an official MCP server page, indicating a real, documented integration rather than just marketing copy.
